operational_requirement.applicability: GM transfers their chosen place-preparation text into an existing place/note; source tool has no observed map-placement control.
operational_requirement.trigger_or_user_action: Save chosen preparation for an existing place, then change generator category or reroll unrelated content and reload saved map.

inputs_and_units.own_test_note: Town A | tavern B | 4 residents | 1 keeper | 4 patrons
inputs_and_units.source_context: Selected Town includes 4 residents and nested tavern with keeper + 4 patrons in inspected samples; no universal random-content guarantee.

operational_requirement.product_operation: Use existing content.place_description to store the exact chosen note, with source URL and selected category/location recorded as provenance where supported; no silent reroll during save/load. Reuse content.roll_table_resolution for any future structured recipe, without creating Eem-specific duplicate mechanics.
operational_requirement.expected_output: place-01 retains exact test note through save/load. Reroll of other content leaves stored text unchanged. Undo of note edit changes only note.
constraints_and_exceptions: Candidate acceptance for existing shared operation, not a new authorized feature or claimed implementation.
No automatic scrape/import, copyrighted table ingestion, Eem binding or integration implemented.
Unselected generators, internal RNG distributions/seeds, authentication/private persistence and full Core rules are outside inspected corpus.
Source application's in-page retention and loss after reload are observations, not a requirement that HexCrawl copy the loss.

acceptance_cases.given: Saved map fixture place-01 has empty note; existing geography and POIs fixed
acceptance_cases.when: Set own_test_note exactly and save/reload map
acceptance_cases.expected: Exact note text survives; geography and POIs unchanged; no random-generation action invoked.

acceptance_cases.given: place-01 retains chosen text; another place is selected
acceptance_cases.when: Reroll only other place content, save/reload
acceptance_cases.expected: place-01 text remains byte-for-byte unchanged; only explicitly selected result may differ.

acceptance_cases.given: place-01 note changes from empty to own_test_note in one edit
acceptance_cases.expected: place-01 note is empty; all pre-existing geographic objects remain unchanged.

operational_requirement.source_vs_product_interpretation: Live source demonstrates compound preparation and volatile unsaved state; saveable attachment is analyst reuse criterion. HexCrawl runtime at exact SHA is unknown in this resource-only run; task status is not implementation proof.
operational_requirement.backlog_disposition: No new source rule or distinct product gap established beyond existing shared note/table operations; unified backlog preserved.
